criterion: OS 檢查映射可追溯規則、設計版本及 AC，區別三階段與判定方式；必要設計分析不延後至驗收，主機模擬不冒充目標證據，缺失正確阻擋相依工作且未完成整體验收不得標完成。
method: Source/contract review and actual executable host regressions
finding: OS checks map design, implementation and acceptance separately. Tests require phase evidence without premature runtime results at design time. Runtime failures route through diagnosing-bugs and selected verification-ladder/on-device evidence; human collaboration remains supported.
